single.rationale: Huntsman faces severe deterioration in fundamentals with revenue declining 29% from 2022 to 2025, operating margins turning negative (-2.3%), and consecutive years of net losses totaling $473M over 2024-2025. The company operates in cyclical commodity chemicals with intense competition from BASF, Dow, and Chinese players, while debt has grown to $2.0B despite shrinking cash generation.
